attributes.accessibilityText:
Stay connected after a reboot
Set up ✓ — after a reboot the app turns Wireless debugging back on and reconnects by itself. No re-pairing, no re-typing.
Not advised on this phone until it has the May 2026 security update — see the warning at the top.
Innocent holds WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. That is what lets it switch Wireless debugging back on by itself. It stays granted until you hand it back, even if the switch above is off.

attributes.text: Not connected. Tap Connect — if that doesn't work, open Wireless debugging (button above) and make sure it's still on, then try again.

attributes.accessibilityText: Use this if "Pair" with only the code fails — usually because the network blocks mDNS (e.g. a VPN forcing a 169.254.x.x address). Copy the IP:Port exactly as shown on screen.
Once connected, scan for videos inside Android/data and Android/obb (Telegram and other app caches) — folders the app itself can't read, but ADB can.
